description: This is a header file defining a 'Monitor' plugin class within the WPEFramework namespace. It declares the class with nested classes for configuration, data structures for memory measurements, JSON serialization containers, and a nested 'MonitorObjects' class that implements monitoring, notification, and restart logic for observing system memory and operational status. The file includes method declarations for initialization, deinitialization, web request processing, and event handling, with various detailed nested class definitions to support memory and operational monitoring functionalities.

classes.name: Monitor
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing monitoring functionality, including system memory, operational status, and restart handling.

classes.name: Monitor::MetaData
classes.description: Class collecting system memory and process metrics, providing measurement and operational status.

classes.name: Monitor::Data
classes.description: JSON serializable container for memory metrics data, including restart information.

classes.name: Monitor::MetaData::Measurement
classes.description: Sub-container representing min, max, average, and last measurements for memory metrics.

classes.name: Monitor::Config
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up monitoring observables and limits.

classes.name: Monitor::Config::Entry
classes.description: Configuration entry for individual observable monitoring parameters.

classes.name: Monitor::MonitorObjects
classes.description: Manages active monitoring objects, their state, and evaluation logic for operational and memory thresholds, including notification and restart policies.

classes.name: Monitor::MonitorObjects::MonitorObject
classes.description: Represents a single monitored entity with thresholds, slots for scheduling evaluations, and restart logic.

methods.name: Monitor::Initialize
methods.description: Performs first-time plugin initialization with service info.

methods.name: Monitor::Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests with potential payload data.

methods.name: Monitor::Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates appropriate responses.

methods.name: Monitor::event_action
methods.description: Triggers event notifications related to monitor actions, such as restarts or deactivations.
